$comment: Generated from src/lib/api/v1-schemas.ts by scripts/api/export-schemas.ts. Don't edit.

BAD_REQUEST.meaning: The request was malformed or a value was out of range
BAD_REQUEST.fix: Check the command's flags; nb help <command>

VALIDATION.meaning: A value didn't pass the server's checks
VALIDATION.fix: Fix the value named in the message

UNAUTHORIZED.meaning: No valid sign-in: missing, expired, revoked, or unused for 90 days

FORBIDDEN.meaning: You're signed in but can't do this here
FORBIDDEN.fix: Check you're a member of the workspace: nb whoami

SCOPE_MISSING.meaning: This token wasn't given that permission
SCOPE_MISSING.fix: Sign in again with nb login, or make a token with more access in Settings

ACCESS_REQUESTED.meaning: The agent lacks this permission, so it asked the person in their NetworkBase inbox
ACCESS_REQUESTED.fix: Tell the person; once they answer, try the same request again

ACCESS_DENIED_BY_PERSON.meaning: The person said no to this permission; the agent won’t ask again for 24 hours
ACCESS_DENIED_BY_PERSON.fix: Leave it to the person for now

WORKSPACE_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: An agent token only reaches the workspace it was approved for
WORKSPACE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Use the folder linked to that workspace, or approve a new agent sign-in

AGENT_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: The organization doesn't allow AI agents here (or on this assignment)
AGENT_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Do this one yourself, or ask the organization's admins

AGENTS_PAUSED.meaning: Agents are paused in this workspace
AGENTS_PAUSED.fix: Turn agents back on in workspace settings

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.meaning: This needs a fresh sign-in check
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.fix: Confirm it in the browser, then try again

NOT_FOUND.meaning: No such workspace, task or file, or you can't see it
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the number or path: nb task list, nb file list

EXPIRED.meaning: It's gone: undone already, older than 24 hours, or a code ran out

CONFLICT.meaning: Someone changed it first, or it's in a state that doesn't allow this
CONFLICT.fix: Look at it again, then retry

VERSION_CONFLICT.meaning: A newer version was pushed since your pull
VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: nb pull, then push again, or nb resolve <path>

TASK_CHANGED.meaning: The task changed since you read it

FILE_LOCKED.meaning: Someone is editing this file in an editor
FILE_LOCKED.fix: Wait for them to finish, or ask them

CLIENT_TOO_OLD.meaning: This version of nb is too old for the server

NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.meaning: An agent's big change waits for the person's yes
NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.fix: Show the summary; on a yes, send the same request with the confirm token (--confirm)

SECRET_DETECTED.meaning: A file looks like it holds a password or key
SECRET_DETECTED.fix: Remove it, or push with --confirm-secrets if it's safe (agents can't)

CONTENT_MISMATCH.meaning: The bytes that arrived don't match their hash

CONTENT_NOT_READY.meaning: The file is listed but its content isn't stored yet (an import still fetching it)
CONTENT_NOT_READY.fix: Pull again later; nb pull skips it meanwhile

CHANGE_SETS_OFF.meaning: Change sets aren't turned on for this workspace yet
CHANGE_SETS_OFF.fix: Push with nb push for now

CHANGE_SET_LIMIT.meaning: Too many open change sets (3 per agent sign-in, 10 per person, per workspace)
CHANGE_SET_LIMIT.fix: nb change list, then finish or discard one

CHANGE_SET_CLOSED.meaning: The change set was applied, discarded or undone, so it takes no more changes
CHANGE_SET_CLOSED.fix: nb change start for a new one, or nb change copy <id>

CHANGE_SET_TOO_LARGE.meaning: A change set holds at most 2,000 files and 500 MB
CHANGE_SET_TOO_LARGE.fix: Split it into smaller change sets, for example by folder

CHANGE_SET_NOT_READY.meaning: The change set isn't finished, or has no files

CHANGE_SET_CONFLICT.meaning: Files in the change set changed since it started
CHANGE_SET_CONFLICT.fix: nb change view <id> to see them, then nb change resolve <path>

CONTENT_MISSING.meaning: Some files' content hasn't been uploaded yet
CONTENT_MISSING.fix: Wait for nb change status to show all uploaded, then finish again

FILE_TOO_LARGE.meaning: One file is over the 25 MB limit
FILE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Leave it out of the change set (add it to .nbignore)

BAD_PATH.meaning: The path can't be used (.., a Windows-reserved name, or a folder that's never synced)

STORAGE_LIMIT.meaning: Your drafts in this workspace are over 1 GB
STORAGE_LIMIT.fix: Apply or discard some change sets first

UNDO_BLOCKED.meaning: Some files changed since the change set was applied
UNDO_BLOCKED.fix: nb change undo <id> --partial undoes the rest

CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH.meaning: The bytes that arrived don't match their hash

RATE_LIMITED.meaning: Too many requests from this token
RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait for the time in Retry-After

NOT_SUPPORTED.meaning: The server doesn't do this yet

UNAVAILABLE.meaning: A service the server needs is down

INTERNAL_ERROR.fix: Try again; if it keeps happening, nb feedback

USAGE.meaning: The command was missing something or had a value it can't use

UNKNOWN_COMMAND.meaning: There's no command by that name
UNKNOWN_COMMAND.fix: nb help lists them; the error suggests the closest one

UNKNOWN_FLAG.meaning: That command has no such flag

NOT_SIGNED_IN.meaning: This computer has no sign-in for NetworkBase

NOT_LINKED.meaning: This folder isn't linked to a workspace

WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No workspace by that name in your list

LEARN_STEP_FAILED.meaning: A step of nb learn didn't work (the step's own error is above it)
LEARN_STEP_FAILED.fix: Run nb learn again; it picks up the same practice workspace

TASK_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No task by that number or words in this workspace

DOC_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No doc by that name in this workspace

NOT_A_TASK.meaning: That inbox item isn't about a task

NOTHING_TO_APPROVE.meaning: The task isn't waiting for review

NEEDS_INPUT.meaning: The command needs a choice and there's no terminal to ask in
NEEDS_INPUT.fix: Answer with --answer key=value, or --yes for the recommended choice

DRY_RUN.meaning: --dry-run stopped before the first change and showed it
DRY_RUN.fix: Run the same command without --dry-run to make the change

CANCELLED.meaning: You stopped it; nothing was changed
CANCELLED.fix: Run the command again when ready

OFFLINE.meaning: The server couldn't be reached; pushes wait in the queue
OFFLINE.fix: nb doctor checks the connection; nb sync sends the queue

TIMEOUT.meaning: The server took too long to answer
TIMEOUT.fix: Try again; nb doctor checks the connection

SERVER_ERROR.meaning: The server answered with something the CLI can't read
SERVER_ERROR.fix: Try again in a minute; nb doctor checks the connection

UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.meaning: The server's answer wasn't what the CLI expected

LOCAL_CONFLICT.meaning: Your copy and the server's both changed

READ_ONLY.meaning: You can read this workspace but not change it
READ_ONLY.fix: Ask the owner for edit access

PLAN_LIMIT_FILE_SIZE.meaning: The file is bigger than your plan allows
PLAN_LIMIT_FILE_SIZE.fix: Make it smaller, or see the limits in Settings → Plan

LOCKED.meaning: Another nb command is working in this folder
LOCKED.fix: Wait for it to finish, then run this again

UNSAFE_PATH.meaning: A file path would land outside the linked folder, so it was refused
UNSAFE_PATH.fix: Rename the file in the app, then nb pull

RESERVED_NAME.meaning: Windows can't hold a file with that name
RESERVED_NAME.fix: Rename the file in the app, then nb pull

CORRUPT_STATE.fix: nb doctor; relinking with nb init keeps your files

CORRUPT_DOWNLOAD.meaning: A download didn't match its checksum, so it wasn't saved

UPLOAD_FAILED.fix: Run nb push again; it picks up where it stopped

CONFIRMATION_INVALID.meaning: That --confirm token is wrong or expired
CONFIRMATION_INVALID.fix: Run the command without --confirm to get a new one

UPGRADE_FAILED.fix: Run npm i -g @networkbase/cli@latest yourself to see why

GIT_FAILED.meaning: A git command nb ran failed
GIT_FAILED.fix: Run the git command yourself to see why

EDITOR_FAILED.meaning: Your editor exited with an error

UNKNOWN_TOOL.meaning: An agent asked for a tool nb mcp doesn't have
UNKNOWN_TOOL.fix: Restart the agent so it reads the current tool list

INTERNAL.fix: If it keeps happening, tell us: nb feedback
